name: Oracle
about: No lab-tested knowledge yet: DBaba recognises Oracle from its syntax or error format and answers with general SQL reasoning plus the notes below. These are notes from the official docs, not lab-proven rules.
weak_why: NVL, DUAL and DECODE also work on MariaDB (and DUAL on MySQL), so alone they don't show Oracle.

notes.limit: Oracle has no LIMIT: use FETCH FIRST n ROWS ONLY (12c and later) or ROWNUM in an outer query.
notes.concat: || joins text on Oracle; an empty string is NULL on Oracle, so || skips it.
notes.null_fn: NVL(x, 0) is Oracle's null replacement; COALESCE works too and is portable.
notes.full_join: FULL OUTER JOIN is supported; the old (+) outer-join marker is still accepted but the JOIN syntax is clearer.
